notes.title: Frog Detective Language Update
notes.content:
Hello frog fans,

I’m very pleased to announce today that Frog Detective is now available in Japanese! We’ve been working hard with 8-4 to make the translation as true to the original as possible so more people worldwide can solve the mystery too. I’m super proud of the work the team has done and though I can’t speak or read the language myself, I saw all the symbols and thought to myself “I bet that would be funny if I could understand it!”. Luckily for me the game is also available in English which I understand pretty well. Whichever language you choose to play in, I hope you enjoy our silly little series and maybe even figure out whether crime is real!

All the best,
Grace Bruxner

notes.title: Assorted Frog Detective News
notes.content:
Hello........
It has been a while..... It’s because we forgot about the Steam news feature......
But here we are again......

Okay, here is an update for you! 

No, it’s not another game. You can leave angry comments all you want, I’ve taught myself how to not read so it won't be an issue for me. If you have been following along on social media or perhaps any major news outlet, you would know that we have released the game on consoles. However because this is Steam we must respect that we should not be advertising the game on other platforms. So, for this reason, I must insist that you do NOT [url=https://frogdetective.net/]purchase the game[/url] on any of the [url=https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/frog-detective-the-entire-mystery-switch/]three[/url] [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10004552]popular[/url] [url=https://www.xbox.com/en-au/games/store/frog-detective-the-entire-mystery/9n0m3gvb0knn]consoles[/url] that we have released it on. DON’T!!! Guys seriously… Seriously I’m not even joking dude… It’s not funny, put your credit card down.

That’s news #1. Second news… Related to the first news… Is that we have a physical edition of Frog Detective: The Entire Mystery coming out! You can [url=https://www.fangamer.com/collections/frog-detective]pre-order on Fangamer here[/url]. But again I must insist that you IMMEDIATELY throw away the cartridge if this Steam post has inspired you to purchase it. And then buy it again on Steam for good measure. Just to be safe, you get it. Fangamer also has nice things like shirts and plushies if that’s your thing. 

[url=https://www.fangamer.com/collections/frog-detective][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33778951/0b40a787e83401a8e2b5553015183a01657ad5a1.png[/img][/url]

Third news, relating to physical items available for purchase. Dan Golding’s amazing soundtrack is [url=https://www.iam8bit.com/products/frog-detective-vinyl-soundtrack]coming to Vinyl[/url]! You can put it in your ears, your record player, your fridge, do whatever you want within local laws. It’s a really pretty green vinyl with a nice cover made by artist [url=https://www.natalie-andrewson.com/]Natalie Andrewson[/url]. So if you’re into beautiful tunes this one's for you.

[url=https://www.iam8bit.com/products/frog-detective-vinyl-soundtrack][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33778951/3d37a5bf311cd69af3f8a44d0eb30babedae9506.png[/img][/url]

As far as announcements about any games we’re working on etc, Grace (me) is taking a big break from everything and enjoying living in a post-frog detective world. Tom is working on his own projects and helping out with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1685740/Surf_Club/]Olivia Haines’ Surf Club[/url], which looks incredible. I simply cannot wait! Thanks as always for your unbelievable support on our silly little game, you have changed our lives immensely. 

Much love, 

Grace xoxo

notes.title: Frog Detective 3 review
notes.content: The Frog Detective series is distilled joy. Simple, brief, but extremely funny and occasionally heart-warming, they're the sort of games that defy you to feel blue when you're done. And Frog Detective 3: Corruption at Cowboy County is the best of the lot... Read more.

notes.title: Frog Detective 3: Corruption At Cowboy County review: a final farewell to a loveable series
notes.content:
The last Frog Detective game is here, marking the end of an era for everyone's favourite amphibian-based mystery game series. Our froggy pal has saved a haunted island from the clutches of ghosts, thwarted wizardous party-poopers in Warlock Woods, and now their investigatory prowess has taken him to the wild west. Frog Detective 3: Corruption At Cowboy County may be the last in Worm Club's trio of Frog Detective games, but it's also a certified banger, successfully joining the first and second games in putting a stupid smile on my face for the entire time I played.
